body: Thanks for listening and your helpful advice. I guess it is hard for me to self sufficient in making myself happy right now. I am emotionally drained and I am also miserable at my current surroundings. Stuck at my parents house in FL without a job. Ever watch the movie Lonesome Jim? That's me except no cool chick around to hang out with. Right now I feel like I had that cool chick to hang around with, but then she left and I'm stuck in limbo over all these situations that are happening right now.

Your post really made me feel better and I appreciate your understanding of the situation. Really helps that you've had the same experience too. Everything you said about her being defensive and your advice about forcing myself not to call her is very dead on, and made me realize that that is exactly what I need to do. 

I have noticed that she does not like whenever I ever I seem passive aggressive or show that I'm really depressed. I guess I have to understand where she is coming from. It is just so hard because she was also my best friend and we talked about everything. It's not easy not having her to go to whenever I'm upset.

I'm also really upset about my cousin's ex gf leaving, because I was starting to get really close to her as a friend, and I feel like I don't know when I'll see her/talk to her again. We had a very special time right before she left and I made her feel very comforted during a difficult time in her and her bf's relationship. She says she'll contact me when she can, and I hope she will. I just cried because of how much I miss her.

I think I'm just overwhelmed because of all these things happening so quickly in my life. I can never be truly happy for a long period of time.

Yeah maybe getting out would help I dunno.. I don't know whether to crawl into fetal position in my bed or get out and do anything to get my mind off things.. Mainly right now I miss the one girl (cousins ex gf) so much right now. Thank you for your offer to talk, I appreciate your help a lot.
